description: Backend runtime hardening (Phase 1), fully verifiable in this environment. Introduce three single-sources-of-truth: RuntimePaths (dynamic app-data root + subdirs), dynamic port selection in main(), and ShareUrlService (LAN IP + runtime port + token -> share URL). Add GET /api/diagnostics, make uploads atomic with a crash-recovery sweep, and add a narrow Windows firewall helper script. Dev/test paths stay relative and hermetic (application-test.yml UNCHANGED) so the 27 existing backend tests keep passing. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except that they build on its hardened runtime.
steps: Create backend/src/main/java/com/qrshare/config/RuntimePaths.java as a @Component. Resolve the app-data root by precedence: UNIVERSAL_QR_HOME env > Windows %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing (fallback ${user.home}/AppData/Local/UniversalQRSharing) > macOS ${user.home}/Library/Application Support/UniversalQRSharing > Linux ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-${user.home}/.local/share}/UniversalQRSharing. OS via System.getProperty('os.name'). In @PostConstruct create <root>/storage/files, /storage/temp, /storage/metadata, /logs, /config. Getters returning Path: dataRoot(), filesDir(), tempDir(), metadataDir(), logsDir(), configDir(). Log resolved root once via @Slf4j.

Wire storage to RuntimePaths while preserving explicit-property back-compat. In config/AppProperties.java change storage.path and metadataStoragePath defaults to empty/blank (not hardcoded ./storage/...). In config/StorageConfig.java, storage/LocalFileStorageService.java, storage/LocalMetadataStorageService.java, and service/CleanupService.java, resolve the effective dir as: explicit property if non-blank else RuntimePaths.filesDir()/metadataDir(). Keep application.yml env overrides (FILE_STORAGE_PATH, METADATA_STORAGE_PATH). Leave backend/src/test/resources/application-test.yml UNCHANGED (./target/test-files + ./target/test-metadata keeps tests hermetic).

Add dynamic port selection as the single source of truth in backend/src/main/java/com/qrshare/QrShareApplication.java (optionally a config/PortSelector.java helper): before SpringApplication.run read SERVER_PORT env (default 8787), probe by binding java.net.ServerSocket on 0.0.0.0:<port>; if busy scan 8787..8887 for the first free port; System.setProperty('server.port', chosen) and System.setProperty('app.server-port', chosen).

Create backend/src/main/java/com/qrshare/service/ShareUrlService.java (@Service): buildShareUrl(String token) -> http://<lanIp>:<port>/share/<token> using NetworkService.getLocalIpAddress() + AppProperties.getServerPort(); add activeLanIp() and runtimePort() accessors; never emit localhost/127.0.0.1 unless NetworkService has no real LAN IP. Route service/FileShareService.java buildShareUrl through it (replace the networkService.getShareBaseUrl call). Update FileShareServiceTest mock wiring if it stubs networkService.getShareBaseUrl.

Add backend/src/main/java/com/qrshare/controller/DiagnosticsController.java with GET /api/diagnostics returning JSON: appVersion (default 1.0.0 from a property), runtimePort, activeInterface + lanIp, dataRoot, filesDir, storageWritable (write+delete a probe file under tempDir()), freeDiskSpaceBytes (Files.getFileStore(dataRoot).getUsableSpace()), activeShareCount (ACTIVE count from metadataStorageService.findAll()), cleanupLastRunEpoch (track in CleanupService, may be 0 before first run), javaVersion (java.version), osName (os.name). No raw tokens/secrets. Keep /actuator/health. Add optional app.app-version to application.yml.

Make uploads atomic in storage/LocalFileStorageService.java: write to <tempDir>/<uuid>.part then Files.move ATOMIC_MOVE (fallback REPLACE_EXISTING) into filesDir; reorder service/FileShareService.java so metadata is persisted only AFTER a successful store; on failure delete the temp part and persist no metadata. Add a @PostConstruct sweep deleting stale *.part files in tempDir() on startup.

Create windows/add-firewall-rule.ps1: a narrow INBOUND rule for the chosen port on the Private profile only (New-NetFirewallRule -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort <port> -Profile Private -Action Allow); never disable the firewall; print the intended action and require elevation. The app only detects/advises, it does not auto-modify the firewall.
acceptance_criteria: cd backend; mvn test passes all existing tests (27) with application-test.yml unchanged.

A backend started in the background reports /actuator/health UP, /api/network/info with a real LAN IP (not 127.0.0.1 on a networked host), and /api/diagnostics with dataRoot under %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing and storageWritable true.

Uploading a file returns a shareUrl containing the LAN IP and the runtime port, the blob lands under %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing\storage\files, download SHA-256 matches the source, and delete returns 404.
Starting with $env:SERVER_PORT='8899' makes /api/network/info report port 8899 (single-source-of-truth port selection).
No hardcoded C:\Users\..., localhost, or 127.0.0.1 remains in production runtime/QR paths (dev/test relative paths are allowed).
verification: cd backend; mvn test  (expect BUILD SUCCESS, all tests pass)

Start backend as a BACKGROUND process; poll http://localhost:8787/actuator/health until UP (PowerShell Invoke-RestMethod); GET /api/network/info and /api/diagnostics and assert the fields above; POST a file to /api/files, GET the share, compare SHA-256 (Get-FileHash), DELETE and expect 404; stop the background process.
Restart backend with $env:SERVER_PORT='8899' in the background; GET /api/network/info and assert port==8899; stop the process.
findings: IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED on Windows 11 / JDK 25.0.4.1. (1) RuntimePaths @Component is the single app-data root source; resolved dataRoot on this host = C:\Users\sunny\AppData\Local\UniversalQRSharing (from %LOCALAPPDATA%). Subdirs: storage/files, storage/temp, storage/metadata, logs, config. (2) Fat-jar Main-Class CONFIRMED via META-INF/MANIFEST.MF = org.springframework.boot.loader.launch.JarLauncher; Start-Class = com.qrshare.QrShareApplication (use these for jpackage). (3) Port selection single source of truth = config/PortSelector.resolveAndPublish() called in QrShareApplication.main() before SpringApplication.run; reads SERVER_PORT env (default 8787), probes ServerSocket on 0.0.0.0, scans 8787..8887, sets System properties server.port AND app.server-port. (4) ShareUrlService owns LAN IP + runtime port + token -> buildShareUrl; FileShareService routed through it; metadata now persisted only AFTER successful blob store, with blob rollback on metadata failure. (5) GET /api/diagnostics returns appVersion/runtimePort/activeInterface/lanIp/dataRoot/filesDir/storageWritable/freeDiskSpaceBytes/activeShareCount/cleanupLastRunEpoch/javaVersion/osName, no secrets. CleanupService tracks lastRunEpoch. (6) Atomic uploads: write <tempDir>/<uuid>.part then Files.move ATOMIC_MOVE (REPLACE_EXISTING fallback); @PostConstruct sweep deletes stale *.part on startup. (7) windows/add-firewall-rule.ps1: narrow inbound TCP rule, Private profile only, requires elevation, never disables firewall. TEST COUNTS: mvn clean test = 27 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESS (application-test.yml UNCHANGED, dev/test paths stay ./target/test-*). LIVE VERIFICATION (fat jar, background): default run chose port 8787; /actuator/health UP; /api/network/info localIp=172.20.10.2 (real LAN IP, not 127.0.0.1); /api/diagnostics dataRoot under %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing, storageWritable=true, freeDiskSpace populated, activeInterface='Intel(R) Wi-Fi 7 BE201 320MHz'; upload shareUrl=http://172.20.10.2:8787/share/<token>, blob landed under %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing\storage\files, download SHA-256 matched source, DELETE=204 then share GET=404. SERVER_PORT=8899 run: health UP, /api/network/info port=8899, /api/diagnostics runtimePort=8899. NOTES FOR LATER FEATURES: resolved dataRoot = %LOCALAPPDATA%\UniversalQRSharing (C:\Users\sunny\AppData\Local\UniversalQRSharing on this host). application.yml FILE_STORAGE_PATH/METADATA_STORAGE_PATH env defaults now BLANK so RuntimePaths wins in production; explicit non-blank values still override (dev/test). Spring Security is on the classpath and auto-configures a generated dev password (logged) but does NOT block the public API endpoints used here; worth confirming/pinning its config in a later hardening pass. StorageConfig.resolveFilesDir/resolveMetadataDir are the shared back-compat resolvers; LocalFileStorageService temp dir sits alongside an explicit storage.path when configured so ATOMIC_MOVE stays same-filesystem.
